title: Lentil Cottage Pie with Sweet Potato Mash
summary: A hearty vegan cottage pie with a rich lentil and vegetable filling under a silky sweet potato mash. It’s comforting, savoury and perfect for a cosy British-style dinner.
steps: Put the sweet potatoes in a large pan of salted water, bring to a boil and simmer for 15 to 18 minutes, until very soft.
While they cook, heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large ovenproof pan over medium heat. Add the onion and carrot and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until softened.
Add the mushrooms and cook for another 5 minutes, until they have released their moisture and started to brown. Stir in the garlic for 1 minute.

Add the green lentils, canned tomatoes, tomato paste, water, thyme, rosemary, soy sauce, 1 tsp salt and black pepper. Bring to a simmer, then cook gently for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender and the filling is thick. Add a splash more water if it looks dry.
Heat the oven to 200°C. Drain the sweet potatoes well, then mash with 1 tbsp olive oil and a little extra salt until smooth and fluffy.
Spoon the lentil filling into a baking dish or keep it in the ovenproof pan. Spread the sweet potato mash over the top and rough it up with a fork for crispy ridges.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until the filling is bubbling and the top is lightly browned. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
